applicability: Applies when parameters contain a list of 1-10 distinct integer digits in 0..9 and an integer max_length in 1..4 not exceeding the digit count. Rejects malformed inputs, duplicate or out-of-range digits, booleans, and unsupported max_length values with ValueError. Only counts primes formable from 1 to max_length digits without repetition and without leading zeros.
description: Exhaustively enumerates all ordered selections of k distinct digits for k=1..max_length, skips leading-zero numbers, converts each to an integer, tests primality by deterministic trial division up to sqrt(n), and counts distinct primes via a set. The search space is tiny (at most a few thousand candidates), so exact enumeration is reliable. Uncertainty is limited to implementation correctness; the counting rule matches the source family.
